abstract: Malignant accidents caused by single-phase grounding of distribution lines in neutral grounding system via arc suppression coil occur from time to time, and reliable and selective protection technology is an effective response. The sudden change of phase current generated by single-phase grounding can detect single-phase grounding fault sensitively and reliably, but its duration is short, which can not meet the selective requirements. In this paper, the criterion of phase current mutation based on rolling algorithm is improved, and the supplementary criterion and time delay criterion for judging whether the fault still exists based on phase current mutation and then locking the zero-sequence current are proposed. The zero-sequence current variation proposed in the scheme can still correctly judge the fault under unbalanced load. In this paper, the simulation model of PSCAD single-phase grounding protection is developed, and the simulation results show that the proposed method can selectively and reliably protect single-phase grounding fault from the influence of distribution network unsymmetrical load.

articleTitle: Process and Protection Action of Commissioning Fault of Offshore Wind Farm Grid-Connected Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The fault analysis of the grid-connected system of offshore wind farm and the design of protection and control schemes to cope with faults have always been hot research issues. Most of the existing research conclusions rely on simulation models to verify their effectiveness, and there are unavoidable errors between simplified models of large-scale wind farms and actual offshore wind projects. In order to restore the real situation of the grid-connected system fault of offshore wind farm to the greatest extent, this paper studies the real case of an offshore wind farm grid-connected transmission lines fault during commissioning. In this paper, transient characteristics of each component in three stages of charging stage, system fault stage and system disruption stage are analyzed, and the action behavior of the system configuration protection during the accident is evaluated, and the actual recording data of the accident verify the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A Novel DC Line Pilot Protection Scheme Based on Additional Current-Limiting Control of HB-MMC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The additional current-limiting control of modular multilevel converters (MMC) can effectively reduce the technical demand for DC circuit breaker (DCCB). At the same time, in cooperation with the protection, it can effectively reduce the requirements for line protection speed and improve the reliability of the protection. Therefore, a pilot protection scheme considering the influence of additional current-limiting control is established by using the ideal of integration of control and protection. Firstly, a two-stage current-limiting control strategy is proposed based on the current changing rate and amplitude, which effectively limits the fault current. Secondly, a pilot protection principle of current mutational volume is proposed, which is based on the additional current-limiting control strategy and fault current mutational direction characteristic information. Finally, the performance of the additional current-limiting control strategy and proposed protection principle are verified in PSCAD. The simulation results show that the proposed current-limiting control strategy can effectively reduce the DC fault current; The proposed protection method can reliably identify the fault. At the same time, it has a certain immunity to noise and higher fault resistance interference.

articleTitle: Coordinated Scheduling Strategy of Emergency Resources to Enhance Interdependent Power-Gas System Resilience Prior to Disasters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The trend of integrated energy utilization of multi-energy synergy and mutual benefit makes energy systems more interconnected and interdependent. Proactive scheduling and deployment of emergency resources before the onset of extreme weather can greatly reduce the impact of extreme weather on the integrated energy system and enhance the resilience of the energy system. Therefore, this paper takes a typical integrated energy system of power-gas interconnection as the object, and proposes a pre-disaster cooperative scheduling strategy for emergency resources. Specifically, the joint failure rate of the lines is calculated according to the disaster prediction information, and the set of lines to be strengthened is screened. The fuel exchange process among fixed/mobile generators, mobile gas storage tanks and gas pipeline network is analyzed, and the constraint conditions are established. Aiming at the maximum supply of power and gas load after disaster, a mathematical optimization model considering line reinforcement, fixed/mobile generators, and mobile gas storage tanks is established, and the non-convex pipe network constraints of natural gas network are convex relaxed to achieve efficient solution. Finally, a numerical example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in improving the resilience of interconnected energy systems.
